# Blendtutor Interactive Demo

This page demonstrates blendtutor exercises for both languages on one page,
rendered as a self-contained standalone Quarto project (`type: default`, no
output-dir).

`coi: true` activates the cross-origin isolation shim for webR, which needs
`SharedArrayBuffer`. Because `coi-serviceworker.js:103` registers the service
worker with `register(currentScript.src)` and NO scope option, the worker's
default scope is the directory of the script URL — so the worker must be served
from the page root to control `index.html`. The blendtutor filter's raw
emission points at `_extensions/.../assets/` (a subdir whose scope never covers
the page); `scripts/fix-demo-coi-scope.sh` post-processes the rendered HTML to
point the script at `./coi-serviceworker.js` and copies the shim to the page
root.

## R exercise

Write a function `add(a, b)` that returns the sum of two numbers.

::: {.blendtutor language="r"}
Write a function `add(a, b)` that returns the sum.

```r
add <- function(a, b) { ___ }
```

```{.r .checks}
stopifnot(add(1, 2) == 3)
```

```{.r .solution}
a + b
```

::: {.hints}
Use the `<-` operator to assign the function body.
:::
:::

## Python exercise

Write a function `square(n)` that returns the square of a number.

::: {.blendtutor language="python"}
Write a function `square(n)` that returns `n * n`.

```python
def square(n):
    ___
```

```{.python .checks}
assert square(3) == 9
```

```{.python .solution}
return n * n
```
:::
